name: PostOverride
declaration: public struct PostOverride
summary: One group of settings a post-process volume overrides: pick the group in module, then tick the properties to change. Unticked properties are left to lower-priority volumes and the defaults.

members.name: Module
members.signature: public PostModule Module;
members.summary: The settings group this entry changes.

members.name: Exposure
members.signature: public ExposureMode? Exposure;
members.summary: Automatic metering or a fixed exposure.

members.name: Ev100
members.signature: public float? Ev100;
members.summary: Manual exposure value at ISO 100 (manual mode). Sunny day ≈ 15, overcast ≈ 12, sunset ≈ 10, lit interior ≈ 7, night street ≈ 3.

members.name: Compensation
members.signature: public float? Compensation;
members.summary: Exposure compensation in stops, applied in both modes; +1 doubles the brightness.

members.name: MinEv100
members.signature: public float? MinEv100;
members.summary: Darkest exposure automatic metering may pick (lower = brighter in dark scenes).

members.name: MaxEv100
members.signature: public float? MaxEv100;
members.summary: Brightest exposure automatic metering may pick.

members.name: AdaptationSpeed
members.signature: public float? AdaptationSpeed;
members.summary: How fast automatic exposure adapts, per second; higher reacts faster.

members.name: ToneMapping
members.signature: public ToneMapping? ToneMapping;
members.summary: Display transform that compresses scene radiance into the screen's range.

members.name: Bloom
members.signature: public float? Bloom;
members.summary: Fraction of light spread into the bloom glow around bright pixels.

members.name: WhiteBalance
members.signature: public float? WhiteBalance;
members.summary: White balance: the colour temperature that renders as neutral white. Lower warms the image's whites to neutral (tungsten ≈ 3200), higher cools them.

members.name: Saturation
members.signature: public float? Saturation;
members.summary: Colour saturation; 0 is greyscale, 1 unchanged.

members.name: Contrast
members.signature: public float? Contrast;
members.summary: Contrast around middle grey; 1 unchanged.

members.name: Lift
members.signature: public Color? Lift;
members.summary: Lift: a colour added to the shadows after tone mapping, fading out toward white; black leaves them unchanged.

members.name: Gamma
members.signature: public Color? Gamma;
members.summary: Gamma: a per-channel midtone power after tone mapping; white is neutral, a darker channel darkens that channel's midtones.

members.name: Gain
members.signature: public Color? Gain;
members.summary: Gain: a per-channel multiplier on the whole image after tone mapping; white is neutral.

members.name: Lut
members.signature: public string Lut;
members.summary: Colour lookup table applied last, as in Unity and Unreal: a strip texture of 16 (256x16) or 32 (1024x32) sRGB slices along red and green, one slice per blue step, imported uncompressed.

members.name: LutContribution
members.signature: public float? LutContribution;
members.summary: How much of the lookup table applies, from 0 (none) to 1 (all).

members.name: Vignette
members.signature: public float? Vignette;
members.summary: Darkening toward the frame corners; 0 disables it.

members.name: FocusDistance
members.signature: public float? FocusDistance;
members.summary: Distance from the camera that is in focus; 0 turns depth of field off.

members.name: Aperture
members.signature: public float? Aperture;
members.summary: Lens aperture as an f-number: smaller numbers blur more (f/1.4 is shallow, f/16 keeps nearly everything sharp). The focal length follows the camera's field of view on a full-frame sensor.

members.name: NearBlur
members.signature: public float? NearBlur;
members.summary: Strength of the blur in front of the focus distance, from 0 (sharp) to 1 (physical).

members.name: FarBlur
members.signature: public float? FarBlur;
members.summary: Strength of the blur behind the focus distance, from 0 (sharp) to 1 (physical).

members.name: ShutterAngle
members.signature: public float? ShutterAngle;
members.summary: Shutter angle: 180° blurs motion over half a frame, 360° over a whole frame; 0 turns motion blur off. Samples per pixel follow the quality preset.

members.name: ChromaticAberration
members.signature: public float? ChromaticAberration;
members.summary: Strength of the red/blue fringes toward the frame edges; 0 turns it off.

members.name: AoIntensity
members.signature: public float? AoIntensity;
members.summary: Ambient occlusion strength: 0 none, 1 physical, above 1 exaggerated.

members.name: AoRadius
members.signature: public float? AoRadius;
members.summary: Ambient occlusion search radius.

members.name: ReflectionIntensity
members.signature: public float? ReflectionIntensity;
members.summary: Screen-space reflection strength, from 0 (probe reflections only) to 1.

members.name: ReflectionDistance
members.signature: public float? ReflectionDistance;
members.summary: Longest screen-space reflection ray.
